notes: Names printed: PROBASCO (NOT IMPROVED) 50', MARSHALL AV. 50', and at the bottom WAGNER and RAVINE (names from 257: Wagner Street, Mountain Alley, Ravine Street). Marshall comes north across Probasco from 284/285 (cross: both its lines continue north of Probasco), runs due south past the lots 2601-2617, bends and runs SW off the left edge; this is the same Marshall Avenue as the diagonal on 276. Probasco crosses the top of the sheet with one angle point. Block 2 (south of Probasco and east of Marshall) is vacant; its south boundary (y~7100-7210) is a continuous line at which Wagner, Mountain Alley and Ravine (all coming up from 257) stop, so their north ends are recorded here. Enslin Street's east line is at the bottom-left edge (x~112); its centre is in the gutter and not recorded. At the bottom right a street lettered UNIVERS... lies in the gutter (x>6290) and is left for 278/258. All other lines are lot lines.
